3.translation: ## Generic shapes and the plasmid preset ⟦shared:0⟧

4.translation: On the same six source annotations, change only arrow to block. A block omits the directional arrow without changing strand. The third figure shows the combined geom_feature(preset = 'plasmid') preset: width=0.058, arrow_head_length=0.068, arrow_head_width=1.42 and plasmid Position. It changes several defaults and is not a single-parameter contrast. See [shape choices](⟦shared:0⟧) and [arrow/short-feature geometry](⟦shared:1⟧).

12.translation: ## Share placement between overlapping features and labels ⟦shared:0⟧

13.translation: Compare identity and shared stacking on the same six annotations. Pass the same Position to geometry and text so their lanes agree. ⟦shared:0⟧ places the starting lane before allocating overlaps. Use ⟦shared:1⟧ as a shared starting point for both strands, with the growth direction set independently. Both layouts preserve source strand.

21.translation: Change only double-line spacing to 0.04, then change the centre length_style size. Keep complete source lengths; do not infer them from maximum feature ends. For FASTA/GenBank/GFF3, check IDs and coordinates in [formats](⟦shared:0⟧). Continue with [circular labels](⟦shared:1⟧), [primers](⟦shared:2⟧), [restriction sites](⟦shared:3⟧) and [tracks](⟦shared:4⟧). Preview at the figure dimensions and use the same width/height in ggsave.
